nodes.title: Me
nodes.text: A made-up person: designer, 34, two kids, wants a calmer life.

nodes.title: Be there for my kids
nodes.text: I want to be home for dinner at least four evenings a week.
nodes.quote: Dinner together is the real meeting of the day

nodes.title: Sam, my partner
nodes.text: We have been together nine years. Sam carries a lot at home when I work late.

nodes.title: Missed the school concert
nodes.text: I stayed for a client call and missed Mia's first concert. She did not say anything, which was worse.

nodes.title: No phone at the table
nodes.text: Dinner is phone-free for everyone, me first.

nodes.title: Summer trip to the sea
nodes.text: Two weeks without a laptop.

nodes.title: Earn enough to breathe
nodes.text: A steady income where one lost client does not mean panic.

nodes.title: My design studio
nodes.text: Three people, mostly branding for small cafés and shops.

nodes.title: Landed a big client
nodes.text: A chain of bakeries signed for a year. Great money, endless calls.

nodes.title: More hours, more money
nodes.text: If I stop answering at night, clients will leave.

nodes.title: Calls end at six
nodes.text: After six I answer only real emergencies.
nodes.quote: Six o'clock is a promise, not a wish

nodes.title: A book about small brands
nodes.text: Writing a chapter a month about how tiny shops find their voice.

nodes.title: Balcony garden
nodes.text: Tomatoes and herbs with the kids.

nodes.title: Typography
nodes.text: Ten years of choosing letters that feel like the place.

nodes.title: Cut until it breaks
nodes.text: Remove things from a design until removing one more breaks it.

nodes.title: Burnout last winter
nodes.text: For two months every logo looked the same to me.

nodes.title: Listen before drawing
nodes.text: The first meeting is only questions.

nodes.title: Kindness is a strength
nodes.text: Being gentle with people never cost me a good result.

nodes.title: Say the hard thing early
nodes.text: A difficult truth on Monday is cheaper than a crisis on Friday.

nodes.title: Family first, then clients
nodes.text: When they clash, family wins — unless the rent is at stake.

nodes.title: Sleep seven hours
nodes.text: I wake up at night thinking about deadlines.

nodes.title: Run three times a week
nodes.text: Short runs in the park before the kids wake up.

nodes.title: Grew up with a busy father
nodes.text: I saw my dad mostly on Sundays. I promised myself to be different.
nodes.quote: I promised myself to be different

nodes.title: I am enough without the hustle
nodes.text: My worth is not the number of hours I work.

nodes.title: Coffee after 4 pm keeps me up
nodes.text: Noticed I sleep badly every day I drink coffee after four.

links.note: This is when I decided to change.
Working every evening means not being at dinner.
My answer to the fear of losing clients.
Except when the rent is at stake.
The belief that replaces the old one.
The bakery calls test my six o'clock rule.
